title: 饮食与制作过程词汇
goal: 掌握饮食制作词汇并核对制作过程

points.label: 选择饮食制作的准确用词
保留制作步骤与食物特征

sources.title: 全国大学英语四、六级考试大纲（2016年修订版）
sources.used: 课程内容所依据的考试大纲

body.p: 饮食介绍涉及原料、加工动作和成品特点。译文须保留动作次序及食物的口味和质地。例：Steam the dough until it is soft. 表示蒸至面团柔软。

cards.title: 词汇表：原料
rows: Add the beans to the pot.
Beat the egg in a bowl.
Heat the oil in a pan.
Stir the sugar into the mixture.

cards.title: 词汇表：加工动作
rows: Roll the dough into a sheet.
Bake the bread in an oven.

cards.title: 词汇表：口味特点
rows: Ginger adds flavor to the soup.
The sauce has a mild taste.
The leaves have a bitter taste.
The dish has a mild flavor.
The bread has a warm aroma.
Steaming gives the cake a soft texture.

body.p: 中文：制作蔬菜包时，先把面粉和水揉成面团，再切碎蔬菜作为馅料。面团擀成薄片后包入馅料，放入蒸锅。蒸熟的包子外皮柔软，蔬菜馅味道清淡。制作时也可加入少量盐，使馅料更有味道。包子通常蒸熟后趁热食用。

body.box: To make vegetable buns, first knead flour and water into dough, then chop vegetables for the filling. Roll the dough into thin wrappers, wrap the filling in them and put the buns in a steamer. The steamed buns have soft wrappers and a mildly flavored vegetable filling. A little salt can also be added to give the filling more flavor. The buns are usually eaten hot once they are steamed.

body.p: first 和 then 对应先后动作；soft 修饰外皮，mildly flavored 修饰馅料。盐为可选原料，译文用 can 表示。

groups.fill: A cook prepares a simple meal. The fl{our} is mixed with water to make do{ugh}. Fresh be{ans} are washed and put into a pot. The cook will bo{il} them until soft, then ch{op} some vegetables. A little sa{lt} gives the filling a mild fla{vor}. The cook will st{eam} the filled buns and se{rve} them warm. Their outer layer has a soft tex{ture}, while the vegetables remain fresh and colorful. The meal requires no special equipment and can be prepared in an ordinary kitchen.

groups.text: 中文：先将豆子浸泡，再煮至柔软。加入少量糖后，厨师将豆子压成甜馅。馅料冷却后放入面团，最后把包子蒸熟。蒸熟的包子外皮柔软，豆馅味道甜。厨师可以调整糖的用量，包子一般趁热食用。这种食物可以作为日常点心。

items.why: 原文先浸泡豆子，再煮至柔软，对应第一项。

items.stem: What is added to the beans?
items.why: 原文说加入少量糖后把豆子压成甜馅，对应第二项。第三项把少量说成了很多。

items.stem: When is the filling put into the dough?
items.why: 原文说馅料冷却后放入面团，对应第三项。

options: It tastes plain, with no sugar added.
It is soft, like the outer wrapper.
It tastes like the plain dough.
It tastes sweet because of the sugar.
items.why: 原文说豆馅味道甜，对应第四项。

items.stem: When are the buns generally eaten?
items.why: 原文说包子一般趁热食用，对应第一项。原文冷却的是馅料，不是包子。

groups.fill: A family makes a meal together. The main ingre{dient} is rice, which they wa{sh} in clean water to remove surface starch before cooking. They also ch{op} fresh vegetables and m{ix} them with cooked beans. A little o{il} is heated in a pan. The cook will f{ry} the vegetables briefly, then add the beans. A pinch of sa{lt} gives the dish a mild ta{ste}. The vegetables stay cr{isp}, while the beans are so{ft}. The family serves the dish warm and shares it at the table.

groups.text: 中文：制作一种米糕时，先将米浸泡，再磨成粉。把米粉和水混合，倒入容器中蒸熟。冷却后切成小块，可以撒上少量糖。成品质地柔软，味道微甜。这种做法使用普通原料，糖的多少可以调整。米糕可以作为日常点心食用。

items.stem: What happens to the rice before it is ground?
options: It is steamed in a dish.
It is cut into small pieces.
items.why: 原文说先浸泡米，再磨成粉，对应第二项。

items.stem: What is mixed with the rice flour?
items.why: 原文将米粉和水混合，对应第三项。

items.stem: When is the cake cut into pieces?
items.why: 原文说蒸熟后冷却，再切成小块，对应第四项。

items.stem: What is the texture of the finished cake?
items.why: 原文说明成品质地柔软，对应第一项。

items.stem: Which statement preserves the role of sugar?
options: Sugar must be mixed into the rice flour first.
A little sugar may be sprinkled on the pieces.
Sugar is added to the mixture before steaming.
A lot of sugar is always sprinkled on the cake.
items.why: 原文说冷却切块后可以撒上少量糖，对应第二项。可以说明糖不是必需的，第一项把它写成了必须。
